notes.title: The Return of the Missing Levels
notes.content:
[img][/img]Hi friends :)

We're excited for how much you all enjoy [i]Neighbours back From Hell[/i], and are happy to announce that with today's update, we're adding three freshly remastered episodes.

Prank your Neighbor in new ways in: [i]Laundry Day[/i], [i]Night of the Hunter[/i] and [i]One Little Piggy[/i].

The update also contains minor bugfixes.

Happy pranking!


Changelog:
[list]
[*]added levels „One Little Piggy“, „Laundry Day“ and „Night of the Hunter“
[*]added animated heads for Neighbor and Mother to the HUD
[*]made camera zoom state to stick after trick camera was active
[*]changed pet behavior and neighbors reaction be more in line with the original version
[*]added different background music variations and sneak music toggling
[*]added ingame HUD scaling feature
[*]added fullscreen/window mode toggle to desktop version
[*]imporved UI layout on ultra-widescreen monitors
[*]various smaller bug fixes and level optimizations
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 released
notes.content:
Changelog for update 1.0.4 ( rev. 1724 )
 
[list]
[*]added progressbar display on relevant Woody actions ( NFH1 feature )
[*]fixed woody’s command not getting executed when mouse control is active and the command gets initiated while woody is transitioning between rooms/areas
[*]fixed mousecontrol issue in minigames when disabling vsync or having a very high refresh rate
[*]made electrotrap prank in level „Do It Yourself“ less fiddly
[*]fixed wrong sandcastle graphics after applying the crayfish in level „Mummie Darling“
[*]added missing translation for „Ladle“ inventory item in level „All Aboard“
[*]fixed levelboundary issue at wasps nest in level „Eaten or be Eaten“
[*]fixed levelboundary issue on balcony in level „Barbecue Time“
[/list]	

The developers also started working on adding the 3 levels you are missing so much so stay tuned for more news about that!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 released
notes.content:
Changelog for update 1.0.3 (rev. 1681 )

[list]
[*]fixed broken and non-stylized font when using russian language setting
[*]fixed missing characters when using hungarian language setting
[*]fixed missing characters on systems running non-localized languages
[*]added missing translations for mouse control related strings
[*]fixed controller D-Pad menu navigation
[*]fixed controller D-Pad ingame control of woody	
[*]fixed outro video button being clickable when inactive ( launch menu )	
[*]fixed pausing the game while a minigame is running not restoring mouse cursor
[*]improved minigame behaving differently depending on framerate (if you still have problems with mouse input because of disabled vsync please use the keyboard)
[*]fixed wrong mouse cursor getting displayed on ladle in level „All Aboard“
[*]fixed Rottweiler getting stuck in an enter/leave loop in certain NFH1 levels
[*]fixed Woody respawning out of Rottweiler’s house when front door is unlocked
[*]fixed neighbour/mother thought bubble not getting displayed the first time	
[*]fixed sandcastle sorting order after applying crayfish in „Mummy’s Darling“
[*]fixed beachrock vs. shark-sub sorting order in „Covert Advance“
[*]tweaked neighbour’s watercan → coffee → sunchair cycle in „A Sunny Morning“
[*]tweaked timing of sofa prank in „TV Afternoon“	
[*]fixed Woody triggering Rottweiler while probing sea water in  „Covert Advance“	
[/list]
